vson_p:
# Collective countability: a crowd as a single Aggregate, not 100 individuals.
# Demonstrates: countability=Collective, no per-individual qualities.

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle high :focalLength 24mm :framing wide_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :framedBy (ctx / SceneContext :venue marketplace :atmosphere energetic :timeOfDay noon)
   :depicts (crowd / Aggregate
               :individuation Generic
               :animacy Agentive
               :countability Collective
               :class Group
               :hasQuality (qs / Quality :dimension Size :value large)))
vson_t:
@prefix vso:   <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#> .
@prefix allen: <https://vson.dev/v1/allen#> .
@prefix rcc:   <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix :      <https://example.org/scenes/anonymous#> .

:scene a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Composition> .
:cam a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#CameraView> .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#angle> "high" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#focalLength> "24mm" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framing> "wide_shot" .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framedBy> :cam .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#viewedBy> :cam .
:ctx a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#SceneContext> .
:ctx <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#venue> "marketplace" .
:ctx <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#atmosphere> "energetic" .
:ctx <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#timeOfDay> "noon" .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framedBy> :ctx .
:crowd a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Aggregate> .
:crowd <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Generic> .
:crowd <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Agentive> .
:crowd <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Collective> .
:crowd <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Group .
:qs a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Quality> .
:qs <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#dimension> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Size> .
:qs <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#value> :large .
:crowd <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#hasQuality> :qs .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :crowd .
